segments.ja242:1.1: Bālo vatāyaṃ sunakho, yo varattaṃ [yo ca yottaṃ (ka.)] na khādati;
segments.ja242:1.3: Bandhanā ca pamuñceyya, asito ca gharaṃ vaje.
segments.ja242:2.1: Aṭṭhitaṃ me manasmiṃ me, atho me hadaye kataṃ;
segments.ja242:2.3: Kālañca paṭikaṅkhāmi, yāva passupatū jano [pasupatujjano (syā. ka.)].
